====Copy cat====
{{Checklist|
*Step on the [[platform (Lunar Diplomacy)#Mimic|south-eastern green platform]].
*Talk to [[Ethereal Mimic]]. {{Chat option|1Suppose I may as well have a go.}}
*Click on him, then copy the emote that he performs. He teleports after each correct emote.
*After 5 correct emotes, he'll teleport you back.
}}
